definition: Count of students who began a program in the period. Authoritative start rule to be confirmed with SME.
calculation: Defined count by period/channel/segment. Formula: COUNT(students) WHERE start_date IN period

definition: Count of countable leads in the period from Salesforce CRM. Dedup rule and date stamp definition to be confirmed.

aliases: channel mix,lead source mix,direct vs aggregator,seo vs aggregator
definition: Change in the blend of lead sources (e.g. SEO vs aggregator) that influences blended conversion. Richer SEO mix lifts blended conversion even if per-channel rate is flat.
calculation: Directional: measure % of leads by channel current vs prior period. No fixed equation — agent isolates mix effect vs rate effect.

aliases: conversion rate,channel conversion,lead to start conversion
definition: Lead to start conversion rate within a single channel. Counter-intuitive: blended rate can be up while per-channel rate is down due to mix shift.
Adjustment for starts shifted across the YTD boundary by track scheduling. Directional — how timing normalization is applied today is an open question.
calculation: Directional adjustment: captures starts shifted across YTD boundary. Method to be confirmed with SME.

definition: Count of actively enrolled students at a point in time. Single authoritative definition and measurement date to be confirmed.
related_terms: drop rate,graduation count,new starts,revenue per student
calculation: Point-in-time headcount: COUNT(students) WHERE status=active AS OF measurement_date

definition: Share of students who dropped over the period. Drops divided by base population. Status definition and effective date to be confirmed.
calculation: Drops / Base population. Formula: COUNT(dropped students) / COUNT(total students at start of period)

definition: Count of students who graduated in the period. Reduces active census — nets negative against headcount.
calculation: COUNT(students) WHERE status=graduated AND graduation_date IN period. Negative offset to census.

aliases: credit hours per student,avg credit hours,credit hour load,credits per student
definition: Credit hours enrolled divided by student count. Student tenure bucketing is a driver of decline — to be confirmed.
related_terms: realized tuition per credit hour,revenue per student
calculation: Credit hours / Students. Formula: SUM(credit_hours) / COUNT(students) per period

aliases: tuition per credit hour,net tuition,revenue per credit hour,rps driver,realized tuition
definition: Net tuition revenue divided by credit hours. Net of discounts — confirm what realized/net nets out.
related_terms: average credit hours per student,revenue per student,military student mix
calculation: Net tuition / Credit hours (net of discounts). Formula: SUM(net_tuition_revenue) / SUM(credit_hours)

definition: Share of military students which influences realized tuition (discounts) and retention. Higher military mix lowers RPS but raises retention and LTV.
related_terms: realized tuition per credit hour,lifetime value,revenue per student
calculation: Directional: COUNT(military students) / COUNT(total students). Higher share = lower realized tuition, higher retention.

aliases: ltv,student ltv,lifetime value per student,student lifetime value
definition: Projected total value per student over their tenure. Custom FP&A model — highest risk item, no single queryable field confirmed.
related_terms: military student mix,realized tuition per credit hour,revenue per student
calculation: Custom FP&A model — formula to be captured from existing model. Likely: SUM(expected_revenue) over projected tenure discounted to present value.

aliases: rps,revenue per head,revenue per enrollment,average revenue per student
definition: Average revenue per actively enrolled student. Cross-source metric combining Oracle revenue and census headcount.
related_terms: realized tuition per credit hour,average credit hours per student,military student mix,census
calculation: Total revenue / Census headcount. Formula: SUM(fp_revenue.amount) / COUNT(fp_enrollment.enrolled_count) for same period

aliases: year over year,year-over-year,prior year comparison,yoy variance
definition: Comparison of current period metric vs same period prior year. Standard FP&A variance analysis.
calculation: (current_value - prior_year_value) / prior_year_value * 100. Positive = Favorable for revenue/starts. Negative = Unfavorable for drop rate.

definition: Positive variance where actual exceeds plan or prior year = Favorable. Below target = Unfavorable. Context-dependent: higher drop rate = Unfavorable even if positive number.
calculation: Revenue/Starts: actual > prior = Favorable. Drop rate: actual < prior = Favorable (lower is better).

definition: Cumulative metric from start of fiscal year to current period. Sum all quarters from Q1 to current quarter.
calculation: SUM of all periods from Q1_YYYY to current quarter of same year.
